observedScript:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$version = (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath package.json | ConvertFrom-Json).version
$release = Join-Path $PWD ('.harness-installed-package/desktop-release-' + $version)
$setup = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $release ('Gen-V1-Setup-' + $version + '-win-x64.exe'))).Path
$unpacked = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $release 'win-unpacked')).Path
$verifyArgs = @('exec', 'tsx', 'scripts/verify-installed-desktop.ts', $setup, $unpacked, '--project-memory-retention')
Write-Output ('HARNESS_INSTALLED_VERIFY_ARGV=' + (@{executable='pnpm'; args=$verifyArgs} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))
& pnpm @verifyArgs
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
